call_input.prompt:
Edit the supplied P02 poster only. The one supplied reference is the own immediate parent final image. Produce exactly ONE revised independent flat poster, portrait 4:5, for repair-1. Use case: ads-marketing. Rebuild the typography's roles and its relationship to the photographed pocket; preserve the existing photograph faithfully.

Full original user request and all mandatory content:
덕테이프 포스터로 가상의 접이식 컵 출시 포스터를 만들어줘.
총 2장이고 두 장 모두 세로 4:5야. 실물 촬영 같은 제품 사진이 들어가야 해.
제품은 손잡이가 없는 350mL 컵으로, 몸체는 짙은 녹색 실리콘이고 뚜껑은 반투명 흰색이야.
실제 브랜드나 로고를 쓰지 말고 제품 표면에는 글자를 넣지 마.
아래 표시 문구를 그대로 사용해줘.
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

This call edits only one assigned poster; coordinator manages the total set. Keep all seven supplied strings exactly once, with exact Korean spelling, English case, the space in 350 mL, middle dot, decimal dots, en dash and entire URL. Semantic line breaks are allowed, but no deletion, translation, duplicate or invented copy.

Change the actual information flow and text/photo relationship:
1. Remove the previous giant upper Fold Cup and the lower-left launch/order block. Let the Korean promise become the first and largest message in the upper-left jacket space: two comfortable lines, first line "가볍게 접고," and second line "다시 펼치다". Use substantial natural Hangul forms with open counters, roughly the visual height of the former Fold Cup block. Keep the line proportions natural rather than squeezing letter widths. This promise should be the first message at thumbnail size.
2. Keep FOLN restrained but readable in the upper-right margin, smaller than the Korean promise.
3. Place the three release/order/store strings as a coherent, clearly readable editorial group in the upper-left/left-side jacket space below the promise and above the cup's nearest edge. Allocate enough width and contrast for the entire preorder line and URL at a 720px-wide view. They should participate in the upper side of the carrying photograph, rather than recurring as an isolated lower-left footer. No surrounding box, labels, decorative rules, buttons or additional copy.
4. Put Fold Cup and its capacity/material string into a deliberate local relationship with the actual pocket opening. The name is still substantial and identifiable in a 320px-longside view, but it is now adjacent to the pocket/cup rather than a detached large upper title. Use the large front pocket panel just beneath its diagonal opening: set Fold Cup on a clean baseline that follows the existing pocket lip's rising diagonal, with natural unwarped glyphs and a comfortable visible gap from the real seam and cup. Put "350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵" immediately alongside/below the name on a parallel baseline in that pocket-side space, keeping the whole string intact and comfortably read at 720px width. These are flat poster typography over the photograph, not new embroidery or product labels. Let the existing opening determine the pair's location, scale and alignment. Ensure neither type line crosses or touches the cup/lid contour or stitching; avoid accidental tangencies. The diagonal type group should explain the compact carrying relationship through adjacency, without literal arrows or invented explanation.

Keep the original photographic scene, cup and jacket:
Retain the jacket crop, zipper and seam positions, pocket opening and its occlusion/contact-shadow relationship to the cup. Retain the cup position, diameter, existing collapsed accordion folds, handleless outline, dark forest-green silicone, completely blank surfaces and milky translucent white lid. Retain the lid ellipse, continuous rim/body joint, each fold's contour and depth. Preserve the original soft directional daylight, highlights, shadows, focus, smooth silicone surface and translucent lid response. Preserve the existing jacket weave scale and its variation with folds, light and focus. Do not add uniform microtexture, gritty noise, smooth away real fabric, recast the cup as a different vessel, thicken the rim, add a handle, alter the silhouette or introduce extra objects. The picture should remain real-product-photograph-like; the cup is still a compact folded drinking cup in a real jacket pocket. The supplied capacity is shown through the exact copy; do not invent measured dimensions or performance claims.

No actual brand or real logo. No product lettering, new garment branding, watermark, fake microtext, price or certification. Preserve the photo subject without repainting its materials while removing old text areas and placing the new text. Natural compatible Korean/Latin sans-serif proportions; deep near-black/deep-green text contrast. This is a change of hierarchy, semantic grouping and pocket-edge alignment, not a simple font or color substitution. Keep the revised poster a single flat image.
